articles.summary: Farmers National Bank announces two internal executive leadership changes. Brian Jackson will transition to Chief Operating Officer. Michael Oberhaus will become Chief Administrative and Risk Officer. Brian Jackson - Chief Operating Officer Jackson, who currently serves as Chief Information Officer, has been with Farmers since 2009. He brings more than 30 years of information technology experience to this new role. Jackson has been an integral leader of company-wide operational enhancements throughout his tenure with Famers. He is a lifelong Youngstown resident with a degree in Computer Science from Youngstown State University. Oberhaus joined Farmers in 2015 through the acquisition of First National Bank of Orville. His background includes more than 25 years of banking and financial industry experience, and he has been a certified public accountant since 2012. articles.title: Farmers National Bank Expands Executive Leadership: Brian Jackson Appointed Chief Operating Officer; Michael Oberhaus Appointed Chief Administrative and Risk Officer
